propositions: a disposition-closed child (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) with a durable replacement link does not mint a completion-verifier attestation in the close path by design, creating an exemption

the certification path demands a valid completion-verifier attestation on every closed direct child without checking for disposition exemptions, causing disposition-closed children to be marked uncertified
a disposition-closed child cannot earn attestation by reopening and re-closing because the same exemption branch is taken every time, leaving no non-force remedy

the close gate and certification path have divergent logic for when disposition closes are exempt from verification, causing an unresolvable state where the parent's signature is withheld over a bookkeeping gap rather than missing verification
a disposition close with a live replacement link should forward certification through that replacement rather than forfeit it, allowing honestly-linked duplicates to certify
